message.content: The consensus among critics and audiences alike points to **“Nomadland”** as the standout film of 2020. Directed by Chloé Zhao, the movie follows a woman who leaves her small town to travel across the American West after the collapse of her mining community. It earned widespread acclaim for its quiet storytelling, powerful performances (especially Frances McDormand), and its evocative depiction of modern nomadic life. “Nomadland” went on to win the Academy Award for Best Picture, Best Director, and Best Actress in 2021, cementing its status as the most celebrated film released in 2020.
